div.div:
Fix: one extra C4Q latch in the D3 path (I → Q → QB = +1 UI, +2 UI hops), so the C4QB latch is closed whenever its input changes and D3 updates on C4QB's rising edge, as in Fig. 10.
Latches transparent while clock high. TA0–TA3 change together while C4I is low. Gray = latch transparent. Labels are bit indices bn, TAk carries b4m+k.
